title: Rust Slices
learning_objectives: Use string slices to view part of a string without copying.
Return borrowed views from helper functions.
Choose slices when only part of a collection is needed.
explanation: Slices borrow a contiguous range from existing data. String slices are written as `&str` and avoid allocating new strings.

examples.title: Find the first word slice

compiler_error_examples: error[E0515]: cannot return value referencing local variable
completion_criteria: Learner can describe why a slice borrows data instead of owning it
